## 6. Function

Implement exactly this behaviour (from the reference program's documentation):

```text
Builds the face detector's learned skin table from hand-labelled frames
  (skin_labels.json): a 32 x 32 bit table over the chroma window where skin lies, Cb 96 .. 159 and
  Cr 112 .. 175 (detect_proto.SKIN_CB0 / SKIN_CR0; Cb, Cr as detect_proto.chroma computes them),
  indexed ((Cb - SKIN_CB0) >> 1, (Cr - SKIN_CR0) >> 1); 1 = skin, a pixel outside it is not skin. Each cell counts the labelled face pixels (the
  inner ellipse of each face box: no hair, eyes or background corners) and the other pixels of the
  labelled frames (outside every face box; the not_skin boxes, surfaces that look like skin,
  counted NOT_SKIN_WEIGHT times); a cell is skin when its share of the face pixels is at least
  RATIO times its share of the others and it holds at least MIN_COUNT face pixels. Frames marked
  "test" are left out of the table and scored with it (pixels: face kept, not-skin rejected).
  Writes skin_lut.txt: 32 lines ((Cr - SKIN_CR0) >> 1), each a 32-bit hex word whose bit (Cb - SKIN_CB0) >> 1 is
  the cell, the form object_tracker would hold it in (32 registers), and skin_lut.png (the table
  over the Cb / Cr plane, the face pixels' histogram in green).
```

Per function:

```text
inner_ellipse: Pixel coordinates (ys, xs) of the ellipse inside the middle 80 % x 70 % of a face box.

clip: A label box inside the w x h frame.

cells: Table cells ((Cb - 64) >> 1, (Cr - 128) >> 1) of the listed pixels inside the luma range and the
chroma window (pixels outside either are never skin and are left out).

fixed_rule: Iteration 1's skin test (detect_proto's thresholds) on a frame.

labels: (clip path, frame, faces, not_skin, test) of every labelled frame; street_scene from its truth.
```
